title: Perl 6 for Mere Mortals
summary: Curtis Poe's FOSDEM talk arguing that day-to-day Perl 6 is far simpler than its enthusiasts' talk of exotic features suggests. He compares basic math and string handling across languages.
why: Offered as a pragmatic, convincing counter to the idea that Perl 6 is too strange to use.

quote.text: Here's a talk I gave at FOSDEM explaining how day-to-day Perl 6 is fairly straightforward and easier than people think
